label: post hoc, exploratory (not preregistered); CIs only, no p-values; cannot rescue, explain or qualify P (AB.1)

definitions.SEL: per outer fold, the family with the lowest inner-CV O1 criterion
definitions.F2+cond: F2 with condition one-hot (knows the corruption type); F2's selected cfg
definitions.F2+z: ORACLE: F2 with condition one-hot and true z; F2's selected cfg
definitions.DET: weight 1 - p_hat(z) from the learned detector (secondary)
definitions.ZSNR: ORACLE: two-class matched filter max(mu_cz,0)/var_cz from training-fold moments, true z and corruption type
definitions.RESTORE-CLEAN: the clean decision of the same item
definitions.UNRESTRICTED: vacuous: share of items with max_j Delta_j > 0

detector_secondary.caveat: K2 label circularity (D0074): z is defined after a VQ re-encode; descriptive only, no claim

bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5, item resampling, one index matrix for all contrasts

timing.note: fit at the maximum resource on inner-training items of outer fold 0 / inner fold 0; no accuracy computed
